messages:
alex: PR #68321: int4 crypto kernel batching fix. Planning to merge Tue 2026-03-24 18:00 UTC (10:00am PST) if no blockers. Needs runtime + infra + security eyes. Key changes: enable_crypto_kernel flag, kernel selection path, fallback to software path. Small API tweak: KernelSelector::choose(...) signature changed. @maya @ryan @jen please review. Quick local test:
```bash
git fetch origin && git checkout pr/68321
./scripts/run-smoke.sh --kernel=crypto
```
CI note: network_test failing intermittently on linux-x86_64, logs attached in PR. Canary will be limited to dedicated pool 'dedicated-int4-canary'. If you can't own merge, please assign a steward.

maya: Taking a look now. Will run smoke and perf. Any golden prompts or perf harness to run?

alex: Thanks. Perf harness: `tools/perf/run_batch.py --model gptq-int4 --seq-len 512 --batch 8 --iters 20` — baseline ~420 tok/s, this branch ~495 tok/s (+18%). No memory regressions locally.

ryan: Quick infra q — canary tag actually restrict to dedicated pool? want to ensure autoscaler won't move it to shared nodes under load.

alex: Yes — canary uses nodeSelector: `nodePool=dedicated-int4` and `maxReplicas:2`. Also added fallback policy: if node not available, route to 'cpu-software' variant. rollout policy in orch config: `canary: {percentage:10, duration: 30m}`.

jen: Security: I'll skim the threat model. Any new surface (JIT, dynamic codegen) or external deps? If not, I should be able to greenlight tomorrow morning.

maya: smoke passed locally but saw one NACK on grpc during perf run; rerunning with latest infra HEAD to rule out transient.

alex: Noted — thanks. Also added small guard in KernelSelector to fall back on any transport error.

alex: If anyone can steward the merge at 18:00 UTC in case I'm delayed, please volunteer — need someone to watch canary metrics and execute rollback if latency > 2x baseline. @sara?

sara: I can steward the merge window and monitor canary telemetry. Will post rollback playbook in this thread before merge.

deploy-bot: :calendar: Scheduled canary rollout for pr/68321 at 2026-03-24T18:00:00Z in dedicated-int4-canary (owner: sara). CI status: flaky network_test (1/3). Please resolve or ack risk.

jen: I'll post a short security note by 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC — call out dynamic codegen checks and SSM key usage.

alex: Appreciated. Tagging thread `needs-eyes: runtime, infra, security`. If no objections by 18:00 UTC, will merge and start canary.

maya: Acked. I'll follow up with perf logs and the one grpc stack trace in the PR thread.

ryan: I'll sanity-check autoscaler config and try to reproduce the NACK with a small load test.

alex: Great — thanks everyone.
